name: Kembangan Fringe
summary: Edges of Kembangan toward Eunos / Bedok — EWL-adjacent quieter east living with practical rents and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Kembangan Fringe is the shortlist when EWL adjacency and quieter east texture matter more than Paya Lebar interchange crowds. The pocket sits on the Kembangan / Eunos / Bedok edges; housing mixes HDB, mid-age condos, and walk-ups. Expats land here for car-light hops to Bugis / City Hall and ActiveSG track catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: genset/ATS notice stacks on mid-rises, evening arterial noise, and confusing Kembangan vs Kembangan Fringe shortlists. Compare with Bedok North West for deeper heartland texture, Guillemard East for denser central-east living, and Eunos North when food density wins.
